📌 Tampered Hardware Wallets: Why Where You Buy Matters

Main Points
⏺ A hardware wallet is only safe if nobody touched it before you
⏺ Attackers modify genuine devices and resell them as new
⏺ This post explains how the trick works and how to buy safely




1️⃣ Core Idea — A hardware wallet keeps your keys offline. But if the device was opened and altered before it reached you, the attacker may already know your keys.
2️⃣ Why It Happens — Real devices are bought, tampered with, repackaged and sold again through third-party sellers and marketplaces, often at a small discount.
3️⃣ Example — Users in Berlin and Dubai have reported receiving genuine-looking devices that turned out to be modified before sale.
4️⃣ Risk Surface — Marketplace listings, "sealed" boxes from unknown shops, devices that arrive with a recovery phrase card already filled in or a PIN already set.
5️⃣ Practical Rule — Buy only directly from the manufacturer's official store, run its genuineness check on first setup, and always generate a new recovery phrase yourself.
Final Thoughts

Saving a few dollars on a wallet is not worth the coins it will hold. If anything about the box or the setup feels off, don't use the device.

The Tip Behind Netanyahu’s Stolen-Election Warning

On Election Day, Benjamin Netanyahu pointed to the arrests of three Ra’am activists and warned voters, “They are trying to steal the elections from us.” He did not mention that his own chief of staff and a former aide had helped set the arrests in motion, The New York Times reports.

Police said they suspected a plot to bribe voters and had seized envelopes of cash. Ra’am denied the allegation. Police later acknowledged in court that they had searched at least two homes without warrants. All three men were released without charge.

The judge who ordered one activist’s release noted that the file showed him campaigning for Ra’am and taking part in meetings with candidates. “But that’s not a crime,” the judge added.

Netanyahu’s office initially denied reports that police acted on a tip from chief of staff Ido Norden. After a Channel 12 investigation, the office acknowledged that Norden had passed along information and said he had acted “like any other citizen.”

A lawyer for former Netanyahu aide Daniel Greenberg confirmed his client was the source of the tip and denied that he had tried to improperly influence the vote. The attorney general and state prosecutor are looking into the matter.

Arab-led parties won a record 19 of the Knesset’s 120 seats. Election officials say there is no proof of widespread fraud that could have affected the result.

Whether anyone improperly influenced the police is still an open question. What is already on the record is how the arrests were used. Netanyahu’s chief of staff passed the tip to police, and Netanyahu presented the arrests as evidence that others were trying to steal the vote.

The exchange did not identify the issuing partner or specify whether its decision was directly related to the recent enforcement action by the U.S. Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN).

📊 During the maintenance period, customers could transfer their remaining card balances to their exchange accounts, while transactions initiated before the suspension remained subject to normal settlement procedures. MEXC had initially described the interruption as temporary but has now confirmed that the service will not resume as scheduled.

🔗 Cardholders could receive cashback ranging from 4% to 10%, with monthly rewards capped at up to 800 USDT depending on their eligibility. Applications were already unavailable to U.S. residents under the exchange’s regional restrictions. Customers using the card for recurring payments have been advised to cancel their subscriptions or register alternative payment methods to avoid interruptions once the card becomes inactive.

🤝 PariPesa has extended its partnership with African football legend Yaya Touré for another year. The four-time African Footballer of the Year will continue representing the brand as its official ambassador across the continent.

🏆 Yaya Touré is one of the most decorated footballers in African history. His achievements include three Premier League titles with Manchester City, a UEFA Champions League triumph with Barcelona, and victory at the 2015 Africa Cup of Nations with Côte d'Ivoire. His name is recognised by millions of football fans worldwide.

🔥 Throughout the first year of the partnership, PariPesa and Touré produced numerous videos, launched joint campaigns, and organised prize giveaways that generated an enthusiastic response from fans across Africa. And this is just the beginning!

💙 Trust is built over time and demonstrated through actions. Yaya Touré's decision to renew his contract is a powerful sign of the legendary champion's confidence in PariPesa. When a football icon of his stature chooses to represent a brand for a second consecutive year, it further strengthens PariPesa's reputation as a reliable and trusted partner for African football fans.

🌍 This collaboration further strengthens PariPesa's growing football partnership portfolio, which already includes Olympique de Marseille as its Regional Africa Partner and FC Inter Lagos in Nigeria. Together, these partnerships connect global football legends, renowned clubs, and millions of passionate fans across Africa.

A second year with Yaya Touré. Even more exciting content, stronger trust, and new opportunities ahead! 🔝
